proposals.before: Shichang fought from the Zhiyuan, the fiercest ship in the fleet, matched against the Japanese Yoshino and Nisshin; the Yoshino was the backbone of the enemy line.
proposals.after: Shichang fought from the Zhiyuan, the fiercest ship in the fleet, matched against the Japanese Yoshino and Naniwa; the Yoshino was the backbone of the enemy line.
proposals.reason: Chinese 浪速 is the Japanese warship Naniwa, not Nisshin; the idiomatic English misidentifies the ship.

proposals.before: Shichang was caught in an air pocket and did not sink; Ruchang and the other commanders saw him and ordered a boat to hurry to his rescue.
proposals.after: Shichang was kept afloat by a life buoy and did not sink; Ruchang and the other commanders saw him and ordered a boat to hurry to his rescue.
proposals.reason: 氣圈 here is a flotation ring/life buoy, not an 'air pocket'; the mistranslation obscures how he stayed afloat.

proposals.before: Shichang's body was ringed by an air pocket and did not sink; Ruchang and the other commanders saw this and ordered a rescue boat sent at speed.
proposals.after: Shichang's body was ringed by a life buoy and did not sink; Ruchang and the other commanders saw this and ordered a rescue boat sent at speed.
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise renders 氣圈 as 'air pocket' instead of a life buoy/flotation ring.

proposals.before: He refused to be pulled aboard, slipped his arm from the air pocket, and drowned.
proposals.after: He refused to be pulled aboard, slipped his arm from the life buoy, and drowned.
proposals.reason: Continues the 氣圈 mistranslation as 'air pocket'; should be life buoy.

proposals.before: The Jiyuan fled with Japanese ships in pursuit; Commander Fang Boyian ran up a white flag, which only made the pursuit fiercer; a sailor fired back and knocked down the enemy's signal mast; Boyian then falsely claimed a victory and withdrew to block the eastern and western entrances to Weihai.
proposals.after: The Jiyuan fled with Japanese ships in pursuit; Commander Fang Boqian ran up a white flag, which only made the pursuit fiercer; a sailor fired back and knocked down the enemy's signal mast; Boqian then falsely claimed a victory and withdrew to block the eastern and western entrances to Weihai.
proposals.reason: 方柏謙 is standardly Fang Boqian; 'Boyian' is a corrupted romanization in the idiomatic English.

proposals.before: When the Japanese came up, he directed the gun crews in their defense; after three hours of fierce fighting three enemy ships were sunk, and he covered the landing of eight battalions of Liu Mingchuan's army by holding the sea long enough for them to get ashore.
proposals.after: When the Japanese came up, he directed the gun crews in their defense; after three hours of fierce fighting three enemy ships were sunk, and eight battalions of the Ming Army were transported and able to land by seizing the interval.
proposals.reason: Chinese 銘軍 names the Ming Army; the idiomatic English invents the personal name Liu Mingchuan, who is not named in the Chinese.

proposals.before: Shichang then drove the screws at full speed in a fury, intending to ram the Yoshino and perish together; he was struck by its torpedo and the boiler ship split apart and sank.
proposals.after: Shichang then drove the screws at full speed in a fury, intending to ram the Yoshino and perish together; he was struck by its torpedo, the boilers burst, and the ship split apart and sank.
proposals.reason: 鍋船裂沉 means the boilers (burst and) the ship split and sank; 'boiler ship' is a fused mistranslation.

decisions.reason: s0070 pairs 吉野 with 浪速. 浪速 is the Japanese cruiser Naniwa; Nisshin (日進) is a different ship and is not in the Chinese. The proposed replacement correctly names Naniwa.
s0076 has 身環氣圈不沒, and s0077 縮臂出圈 shows he could slip an arm free of the 圈. 氣圈 is a life buoy/flotation ring, not an underwater air pocket; the proposed idiomatic English corrects that.
The same 氣圈 in s0076 is a life buoy encircling his body (身環…圈). Literal 'air pocket' is wrong; 'life buoy' matches the Chinese and the following 出圈.
s0077 縮臂出圈 continues the flotation-ring sense of 氣圈 from s0076. 'Air pocket' is wrong; 'life buoy' is the accurate idiomatic reading.

s0062 names 方柏謙 / 柏謙. Standard pinyin is Fang Boqian / Boqian; idiomatic 'Boyian' is a corrupted romanization, and the proposed forms restore the correct reading without changing the rest of the sentence.

s0097 has 運送銘軍八營，得以乘間登岸. 銘軍 is the Ming Army; the Chinese does not name Liu Mingchuan, and 運送 is transport, not covering a landing by holding the sea. The proposed English removes the invented personal name and restores the source sense.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 運送銘軍八營，得以乘間登岸

decisions.reason: s0075 ends 中其魚雷，鍋船裂沉. 鍋 and 船 are separate: the boilers and the ship split/burst and sank. Fusing them as 'boiler ship' is wrong; the proposed literal separates boilers and ship correctly.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0005 shows English 'Fang Boyian' came only from the bad romanization of 方柏謙; the personal-name claim remains, but en must read Fang Boqian to match the Chinese and the pinyin already recorded.

Accepted r0005 likewise shows given-name English 'Boyian' was created solely by the bad romanization of 柏謙; en must read Boqian while zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence stay the same.
